evals.prompt: Adopt this existing research repository without moving its scripts or data, then prepare a resumable handoff.
evals.expected_output: Inspects, adopts without restructuring, and records a resumable handoff.

evals.prompt: Close this research session and prepare a reviewed Project2026 Notion portfolio payload without sending it.
evals.expected_output: Archives the handoff and creates a reviewable local payload without calling Notion.

evals.prompt: Pixi cannot solve my CUDA and PyPI dependencies. Fix pixi.toml for me.
evals.expected_output: Routes dependency solving elsewhere; this skill only governs the resulting state.

evals.prompt: Choose mitochondrial and gene-count QC thresholds for these single-cell samples and filter them.
evals.expected_output: Uses a domain QC workflow and registers approved evidence only when requested.

evals.prompt: Run STARsolo for these GEO samples and repair the FASTQ read-role manifest.
evals.expected_output: Uses a specialized upstream data workflow.

evals.prompt: Export this UMAP as editable PDF and high-resolution PNG for Illustrator.
Search PubMed for recent MDD single-nucleus studies and produce a source-grounded digest.
evals.expected_output: Uses literature retrieval; registers the search as evidence only when requested.

evals.prompt: Audit this governed research project: child folders contain Pixi workspaces and I need evidence-backed migration guidance without changing them.
evals.expected_output: Reports nested Pixi policy errors and root-workspace migration advice without modifying environments.

evals.prompt: I want to explore QC, clustering, and GRN as separate analysis tasks, review each result before archiving it, and then assemble a publication pipeline.
evals.expected_output: Records the human-selected current question, executes only its one ordered explore task, stops for review, and leaves clustering and GRN queued until the human advances them.

evals.prompt: Run a differential-expression model now and tell me which genes are significant.
evals.expected_output: Uses a scientific analysis workflow; Research Project OS only governs an approved task and durable outputs.

evals.prompt: Inside my approved explore/P0-QC-cell-filtering task, write the first-pass analysis as a reusable framework with helper classes and configuration wrappers.
evals.expected_output: Keeps exploration narrative and linear, leaves one-off logic inline with visible intermediate results, and defers reusable abstractions to pipeline.

evals.prompt: Organize the Python, R, and shell scripts in this governed explore task so readers can understand each analysis step.
evals.expected_output: Adds a concise Chinese outline and matching numbered Chinese section headings to every script while preserving English code identifiers.

evals.prompt: Create a Markdown record for my research dialogue with AI. I will maintain the questions, and the agent must answer them one by one instead of running every downstream analysis.
evals.expected_output: Uses a human-owned QUESTIONS.md, treats queued questions as discussion-only, and waits for explicit approval before one current explore task.
